title: build the new cards and review them
summary: approved NEW proposals → new cards in `card-library/<type>/<name>/` + `catalog.json` entries, committed and pushed. Skipped when nothing is NEW. **Then the owner reviews the built card**: landing it flips its plan item `new` → `existing`, which resets the 037 approval by design, so a card nobody has looked at cannot reach 090. Procedure lives in `card-library/CLAUDE.md`
